title: Enterprises with AI context layers report agent failures at more than twice the rate of those without one
summary: RAG remains the default context source, and nearly one in five enterprises are running agents on long-context loading or no structured context layer at all. Sixty-three percent of enterprises are already building or running a governed context layer.
